preflight: Check actual training provenance and permission for each candidate; train_ready is not automatic legal/semantic approval for a new experiment.
An independent oracle must select two genuine semantic Pattern corrections differing from bootstrap; no self-label from bootstrap may serve as independent gold.
Verify source-disjointness and semantic-family separation from training; some heldout archives share phrase families, so not all candidates are automatically eligible.
Choose/freeze 12 real cases and 16 verifier candidate responses with independent positive and negative verdicts before running either arm.
Require trained tokenizer correction to generalize beyond exact training input and produce a changed key; otherwise mark NOT_DISCRIMINATING.
